import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+")


def top_words(text, k):
    """Return the k most common words in text.

    Words are case-insensitive maximal runs of ASCII letters and apostrophes.
    Results are sorted by count descending, then alphabetically.
    """
    counts = Counter(word.lower() for word in _WORD_RE.findall(text))
    ranked = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return ranked[:k]
